surface: reserved/engines income-tax work package: non-savings income tax, Class 4 NI, annual Self Assessment student loans, and gross Relief-at-Source pension contributions.

classification_values.mandatory_executable: Fixture maps to the current engine surface and has an adapter; the release gate requires PASS.
classification_values.pending_unsupported_fail_closed: Fixture maps to the current engine surface but describes an unsupported state; the release gate requires an exact fail-closed ERROR with no monetary output.
classification_values.outside_engine_surface: Fixture tests a feature outside the current income-tax engine surface (e.g. savings, dividends, property, MTD, PAYE evidence, HICBC); it cannot contribute a current-engine accuracy PASS.
classification_values.applicable_not_executable: Fixture is within the intended engine surface but has no adapter; it prevents any claim that its pack passes.
classification_values.historical: Fixture is retained as historical evidence and is not part of current release assurance.
classification_values.pending_founder_decision: Fixture classification requires a founder/rules/legal decision before it can be enforced.

RW3_CORE_FIXTURES.json.rationale: Covers the income-tax, personal-allowance-taper, pension RaS, Class 4 NI and annual Self Assessment student-loan families implemented by reserved/engines and mapped by reserved_west/engine_adapters.

RW3_CORE_MULTI_UNDERGRADUATE_PENDING_FIX.expected_outcome: all fixtures ERROR with UnsupportedStudentLoanPlanCombination and no monetary output
RW3_CORE_MULTI_UNDERGRADUATE_PENDING_FIX.rationale: Simultaneous undergraduate (and undergraduate+postgraduate) plan selection is outside the approved annual Self Assessment scope; the engine must fail closed without exposing any partial liability.

RW3_PAYE_EVIDENCE_FIXTURES.json.expected_outcome: excluded from the current-engine accuracy gate
RW3_PAYE_EVIDENCE_FIXTURES.json.rationale: PAYE evidence reconciliation (multiple employments, conflicting evidence, overpayment) is a separate product surface and is not computed by the reserved/engines income-tax work package.

RW3_TRANCHE_H_FIXTURES.json.expected_outcome: excluded from the current-engine accuracy gate
RW3_TRANCHE_H_FIXTURES.json.rationale: Mixed-income ordering requires savings, dividend and property income, which are outside the reserved/engines income-tax work package (declared out of scope).

RW3_V1_PREIMPLEMENTATION_FIXTURES.json.expected_outcome: excluded from the current-engine accuracy gate
RW3_V1_PREIMPLEMENTATION_FIXTURES.json.rationale: Savings, dividend, UK/foreign property, HICBC and MTD families are not part of the reserved/engines income-tax work package; HICBC has its own separate Optimise assurance suite.
